Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, reporting low back pain and stiffness. The
reported mechanism is consistent in kind and force with the lumbar strain diagnosed. Over the course of 18 visits, care consisted
of manual therapy, targeted stretching, and a graded home exercise program, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved
and range of motion returned toward baseline. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar flexion,
which support the clinical impression. Neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and straight-leg raise, was within
normal limits. No prior injury to the lumbar region is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single charges for each
service rendered, with no duplicated entries. Patient was discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if
symptoms recur.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
